## About the Author
Karan Bhardwaj is a Full Stack Engineer and AI/Automation Architect based in Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar, Punjab, India.
He graduated with a B.Tech in Computer Software Engineering from Galgotias University (Class of 2025).
Originally from Patna, Bihar, he has a background rooted in Physics and a deep passion for systems thinking.

His work sits at the intersection of:
- Full-stack web development (Next.js, React, FastAPI, Node.js, Express)
- Generative AI & Automation (Groq API, LLMs, Selenium, web scraping)
- High-performance caching, database design, and search indexing (Redis, MongoDB, MySQL)
- System design and scalable cloud architectures (Vercel, Cloudflare, AWS, Docker)
- 3D / creative web experiences (Three.js, React Three Fiber, GLSL)

## Pages on This Site

### / (Home — Portfolio)
A cinematic 3D portfolio built with React Three Fiber and Three.js. Features a rotating planet,

- Core Pillars: AI & Automation, Full Stack Engineering, System Optimization, Ecosystem Architect
- Tech Stacks: Frontend, Backend & APIs, Databases & Cache, AI & Automation

- Contact: Email, LinkedIn, GitHub, Behance, Instagram, Twitter

### /roadmap
A 3D interactive life-journey timeline page. A camera flies down a winding road with 6 chapters:
1. 2002 — Born in Patna, Bihar. Childhood curiosity about how things work.
2. 2019 — Gyan Niketan school PCM boards and math focus.
3. 2021 — Galgotias B.Tech CSE and first paid freelance project (healthcare scheduling app).
4. 2023 — Complex product engineering (Socioglamm, Carsnbike, PMEDU4U).
5. 2025 — Flyhead Media Associate Software Engineer (caching strategies, Next.js build procedures).
6. 2026 — Creative Volt Full Stack Engineer & AI Architect (FastAPI, Selenium automation, Groq API).

## Key Projects

### FHMNews
Autonomous news platform designed to fetch, process, and publish high-quality content via external APIs with minimal manual intervention. Optimized data pipelines and server-side logic.
Tech: Next.js, API integration, Technical SEO.

### Socioglamm
Dual-module ecosystem using Next.js. Features an E-commerce section for brand advertising and a Community section featuring video/reels uploads. Implemented SSR and dynamic sitemaps.
Tech: Next.js, Redux, Node.js, MongoDB.

### Carsnbike (https://www.carsnbike.com/)
Automotive listing platform with location-based currency switching (USD / INR).
Tech: Next.js, Node.js, AWS, Large dataset CMS. Blog API: https://api.carsnbike.com/api/blog/

### PMEDU4U
Full-stack educational platform (pmedu4u.com) facilitating student enrollment and aptitude testing. Developed an Interview Preparation Kit module with simulated tests.
Tech: React, Node.js, MongoDB.
